THE HOUSE

Rare materials, chosen by origin and character.

THURIS takes its name from the Latin thūs, thūris — incense, frankincense. The house begins with the material at the centre of its name.

Each essence is selected for where it comes from and how it carries itself: its depth, its brightness, its persistence in a room. Nothing is added to make it louder.

Fewer materials. Each one considered.

FRANKINCENSE · INDIA · 10 ML

The material behind the name.

Boswellia serrata, from India. The resin from which the house takes its name.

Resinous, dry, quietly luminous. The anchor of the collection.

Reserve Frankincense

NEROLI · FRANCE · 10 ML

Blossom, held in balance.

Citrus aurantium blossom. Bright at first, then clearer and more composed.

The light of the collection — a counterpoint to resin.

Reserve Neroli

ROSE GERANIUM · SOUTH AFRICA · 10 ML

Green, rosy, unmistakably grounded.

Pelargonium graveolens from South Africa. A rose character, from a plant that is not a rose.

The essence closest to the house's own origin.

Reserve Rose Geranium

RITUAL

Across the Gulf, fragrance is part of preparation.

THURIS enters that culture with respect and as a newcomer. We bring three materials to a practice that was refined long before us.

ORIGIN

Named species. Named origin.

Every THURIS essence is identified by its botanical name and its country of origin — stated plainly, on the bottle and here.

  • Frankincense

    Boswellia serrata

    India

  • Neroli

    Citrus aurantium blossom

    France

  • Rose Geranium

    Pelargonium graveolens

    South Africa

Three origins, three materials. One house.

SMALL BATCH

A first bottling, deliberately small.

The Founding Release is limited to 90 bottles — 30 of each botanical essence.

We chose a small first bottling to keep every stage under close attention: material, filling, finishing, presentation.

When the release is fully reserved, it closes.

Before you reserve

What is THURIS?

A botanical fragrance house. Its first release is the Founding Collection: Frankincense, Neroli and Rose Geranium, each a 10 ml botanical essence.

What does the name mean?

THURIS comes from the Latin thūs, thūris — incense, frankincense.

Are these perfumes?

No. They are 10 ml botanical essences, not eau de parfum.

How many bottles are there?

The Founding Release is limited to 90 bottles — 30 of each botanical essence. The complete Founding Collection uses one of each.

Why pre-order?

The Founding Release is a single, limited first bottling. Reserving secures a bottle from it before dispatch.

Do you publish purity claims?

Not without batch documentation to support them. We will not make a claim we cannot show.

The first trace begins here.
